Qiskit level-3 transpile (windows of 32) of the reference circuit.

dimer frame (pivot = link b) with two clean flags a1=[c0=c2=0], A=[u=v=0] and the third AND a2=[c1=c3=0] toggled straight onto the pivot by two rccx inside the H-frame phase walk (one CZ cancels their leftover sign), plus a 1-CX merge of the last ladder CX with the first walk toggle; 32 CX, 9+4 rotations, all angles k*beta/4 or 3*alpha/4.

F2 single-flag corner polynomial: dimer ladder (pivot = link b), one rccx flag A=[u=v=0], and a 22-step closed pivot walk over the raw corner parities (c0..c3, A, e) carrying 18 rz(+-beta/4) terms; the first walk step is fused with the last ladder CX into a 1-CX Clifford; 33 CX, 17 qubits, all angles +-beta/4 or -3*alpha/4.

searched U_B (scratch/proposer/f3): flags A=[u=v=0], NOR(c0,c1), NOR(c2,c3) (3 rccx pairs), a 9-term pivot phase polynomial (MILP enumeration + exact free-endpoint TSP: 9 pivot CX), and the final CX(e,p) unload fused with the ladder tail into one 2-CX Clifford; 33 CX, 13 rotations, angles k*beta/4 and -3*alpha/4 solved from the oracle and snapped to k/64.

T-lean step with 7 rotations (3 for U_E, 4 for U_B, the minimum for +-1 phase decompositions): U_E = phases on y_b, on the pivot r^t^l and on maj(r,t,l) (one rccx pair onto the pivot); U_B = 4-term pivot walk over B, F, F&~e with B and F&~e toggled onto the pivot by nested rccx pairs and the A flag XORed into corner qubit c3; 17 qubits, angles k*alpha/4 and k*beta/2 (one shifted by -pi/4).

dimer frame (pivot = link b) with one clean flag a1=[c0=c2=0] and A=[u=v=0] XORed in place into corner qubit c0; corners c1, c3 and c0^A enter the H-frame pivot walk as plain CX toggles, so the walk is all-linear (13 CX, no rccx on the pivot, no sign fix) and ends on the e-step merged into the inverse ladder; 31 CX, 13+4 rotations, 17 qubits, all angles k*beta/4 or 3*alpha/4.

F2 with one ancilla: dimer ladder (pivot = link b), flag a01=[c0=c1=0] on the only ancilla, A=[u=v=0] XORed in place into the idle corner qubit c1 (X = c1^A), the 3-AND D=a01&~c3 toggled straight onto the pivot by an rccx pair, and a 10-state pivot walk over (e, X, D, c2) with 9 rotations (first step fused with the ladder, one CZ for the pair's leftover sign); rotation signs set by free pivot X-flips to shorten the Clifford+T words; 32 CX, 13 rotations, 17 qubits, angles k*beta/4 and -3*alpha/4.

F3 searched walk with one direct AND: clean flags A=[u=v=0], N2=NOR(c2,c3); N1=NOR(c0,c1) toggled straight onto the pivot by two rccx (CZ(c0,N2) cancels their leftover sign); 9-term pivot walk from the free preload e to 0 with 7 cheap toggles; pivot sign flips carried by negated toggle controls and p(lam+-pi/2) electric angles pick the shorter Clifford+T words; 32 CX, 9+4 rotations k*beta/4, 3*alpha/4 (+-pi/2).

T-lean step with 10 rotations at 34 CX: U_E = 4 link phases; U_B = 6-term pivot polynomial f = 1/8 + 3/8 Z_F + 1/4 Z_B - 3/4 Z_F Z_B - 3/8 Z_e + 3/8 Z_F Z_e in the dimer frame, B = bright = (c1^X)&Y toggled by a direct rccx pair (X = NOR(c0,c2) XORed into c1, Y = NOR(c1,c3) in one ancilla), F = c0^A (A = [u=v=0] XORed into c0); walk [e] F e B F B (fused start) + one CZ for the rccx-pair sign; 17 qubits, angles k*beta/4 and -3*alpha/4.

parent circuit unchanged in gates that cost CX (dimer frame, pivot b; flag a1=[c0=c2=0], A=[u=v=0] XORed into c0; 13-toggle all-linear H-frame walk over c1, c3, c0^A, a1, e; 31 CX, 17 qubits), but every rotation is emitted in its cheapest exact Clifford+T-equivalent form sg*|th| + m*pi/4 followed by p(-m*pi/4): the 4 electric p(-3alpha/4) and the 4 rz(+-beta/2) take a pi/4 shift (pygridsynth T 64 -> 58+1, 66 -> 64+1), signs ride on X frame flips (pivot or link qubit) and pi/2 shifts on S/Z fixes, picked for the shortest word; T 1086 -> 1062, depth_CT 2258 -> 2189.

dimer frame (pivot b; q1 = E = b^r and q2 = U = b^t both fused into 2-CX Bravyi-Maslov end blocks, flags computed after the frame H) with one clean flag N=[c1=c3=0] and A=[U=V=0] XORed in place into corner c1; all-linear 13-toggle walk E -> 0 over (E, N, c1^A, c0, c2) (the mirror of the F1 walk) with the minimum-T coefficient choice; every rotation picks its X-flip sign and a pi/4 shift rz(th) = rz(th +- pi/4) tdg/t when the shifted Clifford+T word is cheaper, and U_E is p(-3alpha/4 + pi/4) tdg (58 + 1 T instead of 64); 31 CX, 13 + 4 rotations, 17 qubits

F3 one-direct-AND walk on 17 qubits: Na=NOR(c0,c1) in the only ancilla, A=[u=v=0] XORed in place into c1 (idle between the Na compute and uncompute), Nd=NOR(c2,c3) toggled straight onto the pivot by two rccx (CZ(Na,c2) Z(Na) cancels their sign); 9-term walk e -> 0 with 7 cheap toggles, the one walk whose rotations all reach the shortest Clifford+T word (pivot X-frame flips by negated toggle controls only: sum of words 1358 = floor over all 32-CX walks); 32 CX, 9+4 rotations k*beta/8, 3*alpha/4 (+-pi/2).
